scope: Test whether π extension from complete mono-ClPDI-Ph to di-ClPDI-Ph changes corresponding molecular UV/ECD response through electronic coupling or helix/sidechain geometry, using fixed-backbone stereochemical comparisons, a common-subunit geometry control and properly bounded conformer weighting.

controls.mono_di_mapping: Public maps derive from the di graph. Conceptually sever di bonds(9,60),(8,7),(53,54), restore Cl at9,53,60,54 and H at8,7. This produces two chemically complete C40H22Cl4N2O4 monomers; the supplied mono graph is the fragment with N66/N82. Retained atom maps encode the subunit correspondence; newCl maps202/203 identify the restored bay substituents. This is graph reconstruction, not a chemical reaction-energy reference.
controls.backbone_definition: Define the operational M-family by positive signed bay torsions using ordered quadruples [59,58,57,56] in the mapped mono subunit and [31,32,33,24] in the second di subunit. Start both in +15–35° windows, preserve the sign during sidechain sampling; mirror family reverses these signs. Operational signs are authoritative and must not be inferred solely from a drawing. Record exact helicity maps/final angles and any drift.
controls.common_geometry: From a solver-generated di_R M-family geometry transfer the retained mono subunit heavy-atom coordinates to mono_R, restore missingCl/H by graph valence, constrain mapped common heavy atoms and relax only restored caps/sidechains consistently. Compare with independently relaxedmono_R anddi_R; this is a common-subunit geometry spectral control, not an unbalanced energy subtraction.
controls.ensemble_boundary: Sample rotations of N–CH(Ph)Me and phenyl sidechains within each fixed backbone/configuration. Normalize only mutually interconvertible conformers of that member. Do not mixR/S sidechain stereoisomers orM/P backbone diastereomers into one equilibrium unless kinetic evidence supports it. Source VT-NMR distinguishes slow backbone and faster sidechain changes.
controls.spectrum_definition: Calculate oscillator and rotatory strengths with explicit electric/magnetic transition moments and gauge/units. Convolve UVepsilon andECD Δepsilon on the same energy grid with Gaussian0.20eV FWHM baseline and0.15/0.25 sensitivity. gabs=Δepsilon/epsilon only where epsilon exceeds1% of that spectrum maximum; mask near-zero denominators. No arbitrary sign reversal or independent broadening for UV andECD.
controls.mirror_check: One true mirror control inverts both sidechain stereocenters and the backbone torsion signs. Compare equal energy/oppositeECD as a convention test; do not impose it onRRRR-MM versusSSSS-MM.

source_notes: Main PDF p3 Fig1 molecular structure inspected; SI pp7–13 methods, full1-phenylethyl substituents and dynamic stereochemical distinctions.
SI pp27–42 source coordinate tables used privately for connectivity and mapping.
molecular_boundary: Use the complete1-phenylethyl sidechains and exact molecular graphs. Mono formulaC40H22Cl4N2O4 and di formulaC80H42Cl4N4O8. q=0 singlets, dichloromethane. Fix the same M-family backbone for R andS sidechain alternatives; these are diastereomeric comparisons, not necessarily mirror pairs. Device gph and crystal transport are out of scope. All required comparisons are core; the optional extension listed below is not a completion condition. A documented failure is a valid submission but is not scientific completion. Evidence-supported collapse of an initialized basin, or inability to distinguish explanations after completing the core matrix, is scientifically admissible. An unattempted core comparison cannot be replaced by an uncertainty statement.
optional_not_required: Optoelectronic device response and complete solid-state packing are outside this version.
